title: RouteMeta
description: A declarative metadata record attached to a single Route that the SPA router reads at runtime. It sets how that route's view is rendered (layout wrapper, keep-alive caching, enter/leave animation, breadcrumb label) and exposes access hints (requiresAuth, roles, permissions) for guards to read; it carries no URL path and no executable logic of its own. Use Route instead when the symbol defines the addressable path pattern and the component it resolves to, rather than the auxiliary meta/data object hanging off that route record. Use NavigationGuard instead when the symbol is executable interception logic (beforeEach, canActivate, a loader redirect) that evaluates and enforces access, rather than the static hints such logic reads. Use BreadcrumbConfig instead when the configuration sets breadcrumb generation rules, separators or home-link behaviour for a whole navigation scope rather than one route's breadcrumb label. Use NavigationTransition instead when modelling a directed change from one route to another with a trigger, not the CSS/animation name stored in a route's meta 'transition' field.

requiresAuth.description: Hint indicating this route requires an authenticated session; used by NavigationGuard nodes to enforce access control.

roles.description: Comma-separated list of roles permitted to access this route (e.g., 'admin,editor'). Enforced via NavigationGuard.

permissions.description: Comma-separated list of permission strings required for this route (e.g., 'reports:read,users:write'). Enforced via NavigationGuard.

layout.description: Name or reference of the layout component to wrap this route's view (e.g., 'DefaultLayout', 'AuthLayout').

breadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb label or reference to a BreadcrumbConfig node; used to render the route's position in the location trail.

keepAlive.description: When true, the route's component instance is cached and reused across navigation events rather than destroyed and re-created.

transition.description: Name of the CSS transition or animation applied when entering or leaving this route (e.g., 'fade', 'slide-left').

x-dr-standard: SPA Navigation Patterns: Route Meta Fields (e.g., Vue Router RouteMeta, Angular Route.data, React Router route handle)
x-dr-evidence: a `meta: { requiresAuth: true, layout: 'AuthLayout', keepAlive: true }` object inside a Vue Router route record, or a `declare module 'vue-router' { interface RouteMeta { ... } }` type augmentation
an Angular route definition with `data: { roles: ['admin'], breadcrumb: 'Reports' }` that is read through ActivatedRoute.snapshot.data or in a guard
a root shell that wraps `<router-view>` in `<keep-alive>` or `<transition :name="route.meta.transition">`, or that picks a layout component from `route.meta.layout` / `useMatches()[i].handle`
